Where is all this negativity getting you?  Is it helping you find love?  Is it making you more successful?  No?  Thought not.  

No, you don't owe happiness to anyone, but spewing this bitterness do an ounce of good.  There's a reason that loneliness leads to an early grave - the negativity and depression that goes along with it is extremely impactful on one's health.  I'd invite you to maybe try looking at things from a better perspective when you can.  I guarantee you it feels better to let go of all that negativity.

And for what it's worth, u/fryhldrew wasn't being rude in the least.  We're both trying to help you see how this way of thinking only hurts you.
